verdict.rationale: Ledgy's financial reporting module generates equity accounting reports under US GAAP, the framework that contains ASC 718. The reports include tranche-level detail, configurable settings and overrides, and access controls for collaborating with finance teams. Separate equity-compliance material documents one-click reports and exports. Missing for 10: explicit naming of ASC 718 expense reports, documentation of audit-ready outputs or auditor handoff, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors

citations.quote: Generate a broad suite of financial reports instantly to account for equity under IFRS 2, UK GAAP or US GAAP, with tranche-level details in one click.
Select your ideal financial reporting settings, including custom overrides and preferred aggregate grouping, making reports that work for your business.
Control who can access financial reporting to collaborate securely across teams.
One-click equity compliance reports, custom views and exports, make meeting compliance deadlines a breeze.
